title: Tabular Foundation Models as Emulators for Forecasting Terrestrial Ecosystem Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.20468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Process-based terrestrial biosphere models such as the Ecosystem Demography (ED) model underpin global carbon budgets, but their cost limits global, high-resolution and scenario-rich simulation. Deep emulators such as DeepED reduce that cost but require task-specific architectures and training. Tabular foundation models offer a different route: TabPFN predicts new rows by in-context learning, without being trained on the task. We compare TabPFN-3.5 with two DeepED baselines, $DeepED_{LSTM}$ and $DeepED_{Transformer}$, on CarbonGlobe's overall evaluation, which trains on a uniform 1/16 sample of sites and tests on the other 50,779, predicting the 40-year state of all seven ED outputs. We then test every model, trained on present-day data only, on ED runs forced by SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5 for 2021--2060 in six continental forest regions. translated_title: 表格基础模型作为预测陆地生态系统动态的仿真器
translated_abstract: 基于过程的陆地生物圈模型（如生态系统动态学（ED）模型）是全球碳收支研究的基石，但其高昂的计算成本限制了全球尺度、高分辨率以及多情景的模拟。以DeepED为代表的深度学习仿真器虽然降低了计算成本，却需要针对特定任务的架构设计与训练。表格基础模型则提供了另一条路径：TabPFN通过上下文学习直接预测新的数据行，无需针对任务进行训练。我们在CarbonGlobe的总体评估中将TabPFN-3.5与两个DeepED基线（DeepED_LSTM和DeepED_Transformer）进行比较：该评估在均匀抽样的1/16站点上训练，并在其余50,779个站点上测试，预测全部七个ED输出变量的40年状态。随后，我们进一步测试了仅在当代数据上训练的各模型在六个大陆森林区域、由SSP1-2.6和SSP5-8.5气候情景强迫驱动的2021—2060年ED模拟上的表现。结果表明，在完全无需训练的情况下，TabPFN-3.5在三个模型中取得了最低的当代高度误差，并且……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究证明表格基础模型TabPFN-3.5无需任何任务特定训练即可作为陆地生态系统动态模型的高精度仿真器，性能达到乃至超越需专门架构设计与训练的深度学习仿真器DeepED，并具备外推至未来气候情景预测的能力。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that the tabular foundation model TabPFN-3.5 can act as a zero-training emulator for terrestrial ecosystem dynamics, matching or surpassing task-specific deep learning emulators like DeepED while generalizing to future climate scenarios.
